note: Rejudged 2026-10-14 by a reader who did not author the tests. Forbidden: two sessions whose records carry the same Acct-Session-Id in the log. Within one process: TestRFC2866AcctSessionIDUnique (1600 concurrent ids distinct) and TestRFC2866AcctSessionIDNoCollisionOnReusedKey. Across a restart: TestRFC2866AcctSessionIDUniqueAcrossRestart (two accountants built in turn give the same tunnel and session two ids on the Accounting-Start) and TestRFC2866AcctSessionIDUniqueWhenClockRepeats (same clock second: time digits equal, random digits differ, ids differ). Producer authradius/acct.go genSessionID, T-S-<boot tag>-N, the boot tag minted once by mintBootTag at first use from Unix seconds and 64 random bits; uniqueness across boots at one clock second is probabilistic over those 64 bits.
